summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, found this drug has low risk scores for both liver and heart harm [M]. An official government label warns that cigarette smoking raises the chance of severe heart and blood vessel problems when using this type of birth control, especially for women over 35 who smoke [4]. The label also notes blood vessel risks, warning people to stop taking the drug if a blood clot occurs or around the time of a major surgery [4]. In addition, a similar drug has a major warning for nerve, brain, blood vessel, and heart harm [3].
